[SWS_DM_01072] Persistency of defined
DDDIDs
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04246
⌈
If
DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifierClass.configura-
tionHandling
is set to nonVolatile, the DM shall persist
DDDIDs
configured by the
UDS service 0x2C and restore the
DDDIDs
definition from Non-Volatile Memory at DM
Initialization.
⌋
